findings.title: Renamed function without updating call sites
findings.body: The function was renamed from `readSensor` to `sampleSensor`, but the new name does not match the existing convention in the codebase. The file `src/sensors.ts` previously contained `readSensor`, and renaming it without updating all references breaks the existing API contract. Revert the name to `readSensor` to maintain consistency with the rest of the codebase.

summary.problem: The function `readSensor` was renamed to `sampleSensor` without updating the call sites, breaking the existing API contract.
summary.done_well: The function signature and implementation remain correct and consistent with the expected `Reading` type.
